page.description: OmniOS CE editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An illumos-based (OpenSolaris-derived) server operating system with KYSTY minimalist philosophy, released for x86-64 as ISO, USB-DD, cloud, and ZFS archive images.
pros: SHA-256 sidecar files published for every artifact
ZFS boot environments with BEADM rollback
cons: grub bootloader unsupported as of r151054 — must use native loader
`reboot now` breaks boot on the native loader
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for OmniOS CE; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO or usb-dd image to USB with dd. Boot from CD/USB/PXE. Installer dialogue creates rpool; select T for text installer.
